speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn presenting with a generalized rash; to begin our assessment, is your baby currently feeding well, and have they been acting lethargic or irritable?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Ophthalmia (or Gonococcemia) given the maternal history of gonorrhea and the 4-day-old timing of the generalized rash, though I would confirm with blood cultures and a Gram stain of the rash. REQUEST TEST: Blood_Culture, Gram_Stain_of_Rash, CBC_with_Diff.
